apps/web/src/components/motion/scene.tsx.reason: Temporary, a copy of packages/ui useReducedMotion that #848 (shared app components) replaces with it. The reduced-motion change listener of the marketing scenes, added while a scene reads it and removed with the last reader.

apps/web/src/components/motion/m.tsx.reason: Writes each MotionValue change of an m element's style in Motion's render step, with the frame's other writes: the replacement for Motion's own m components, which batch the same way.

apps/web/src/components/motion/scene.tsx.reason: The scene clock of the animated marketing scenes: Motion's update step advances each running scene once per frame, so the frame is the animation itself, not an ordering patch; it stops when the scene stops or the tab is hidden.
Writes an animated data attribute (EvryBot's mood) in Motion's render step, with the frame's other style writes, so a value is written once per frame and never between two reads of the same frame.
Writes animated text (typing, counters) in Motion's render step, with the frame's other writes, so React never renders per frame and a value is written once per frame.
